gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-m-plus-1p: Loose, hand-drawn fun up top, with Shantell Sans wearing its wide-mouthed letters like a grin. M PLUS 1p follows underneath, open at every curve end, so the playful heading never has to compete with the text.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-m-plus-2: Shantell Sans draws every letter with one fixed nib, giving the heading a marker-pen looseness that is hard to ignore. M PLUS 2 comes in below with the same single-width line but a more approachable manner, so the page feels friendly throughout.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-m-plus-code-lati: Expressive and a bit cheeky, Shantell Sans heads the page with a wide mouth in its letters and a steady nib. And M PLUS Code Latin underneath bends its sans lines like neon tubing, giving the heading a tidy, glowing partner.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-m-plus-rounded-1: M PLUS Rounded 1c reads as a mild, approachable sans whose terminals stop short of curling back in. Shantell Sans adds the personality above it.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-mandali: Mandali reads as a plain sans with a generous entry into the e's eye, easy on the page. Shantell Sans earns its keep big and short, where its fat crossbars show.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-manjari: Manjari reads smooth, its curves ending in wide, unclosed terminals. Shantell Sans earns its keep when set big and short as a heading, where its wide-mouthed, marker-like letters can show off against that quiet line.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-meera-inimai: Shantell Sans brings a wide-mouthed, fixed-nib looseness to the heading, as if lettered by hand with one felt pen. Meera Inimai's blueprint-like sans gives it a steady, open partner.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-metrophobic: Shantell Sans draws a single-weight line like a plotter pen, with wide-mouthed letters that feel handmade and lively. But Metrophobic gives the text a smooth, unobstructed path around each bend, so the heading's play stays in charge.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-mina: Shantell Sans leads with a fixed nib and wide mouths, loose and expressive. Mina follows in strokes plain as stitched thread outline, so a heading around twice the body's size feels right.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-mingzat: Contemporary but loose, this pair starts with Shantell Sans. Its pen pressure never changes, and Mingzat's unclamped, curvy plain sans below makes the heading's personality feel entirely at home.
